newsitem.title: USA: Tri-National sets div in MRI shrs.
newsitem.headline: Tri-National sets div in MRI shrs.

text.p: Tri-National Development Corp said Tuesday it will pay a stock dividend of one MRI Medical Diagnostics Inc share for every 19 Tri-National shares on September 15 to stockholders of record on August 31.
The company said the distribution totals 750,000 MRI shares. It added it will distribute its remaining 1.5 million MRI share holding at later record dates.
Tri-National in January started trading on Nasdaq's bulletin board under the symbol "TNAV," and delisted its stock from the Vancouver Stock Exchange, where the company traded under the symbol "TND."
Tri-National's stock closed at 19/64 Monday, while MR shares closed at 5/32 Friday.
